common_rules: scheduled indicates the cycle is prepared but not yet accepting contributions.
Each participant contributes one primary submission during submission_open.
routing_complete is only meaningful for intervention cycles.
digests_released exposes the cycle-specific outputs for review.
reflection_closed follows release and stays separate from the main prompt loop.
archived means the cycle can be retained, exported, or replayed.
failed records an explicit failure state rather than a silent partial success.

visible_behavior: Elevated items appear as a digest after routing.
The explanation panel makes the routing decision legible.
The participant does not see the raw routing internals.
